name: Ferienwohnung Pendling
beschreibung:
Elevated and sunnily situated in Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Pendling impresses with complete tranquility and modern living comfort, featuring a sunny balcony facing the Pendling massif.

Lake Thiersee for swimming and picturesque walking routes through the valley are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Pendling in Thiersee offers sweeping views of Mount Pendling and a relaxing holiday in Kufsteinerland.
